newsitem.title: UK: Reuters transaction products grow in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Reuters transaction products grow in 1996.

text.p: News and information group Reuters Holdings Plc said on Tuesday that transaction products revenue grew by 21 percent in 1996 to 813 million pounds.

It said in a statement accompanying annual results that growth in transaction products was propelled by Instinet, the equities trading system. Instinet turnover grew 42 percent in 1996 to 346 million pounds and has started 1997 "well", said Reuters.
Reuters foreign exchange dealing products had slower growth during the year because of flat markets, although the company noted that 1997 has started better.
It said that Dealing 2000-2, the company's automated matching product for the foreign exchange market, had a record number of trades in January.
Dealing 2000-1, the conversational product, was operating close to record activity levels.
Combined revenues from Dealing 2000-1 and dealing 2000-2 jumped nine percent to 459 million pounds in the year compared with growth of 25 percent in 1995.
